title: Weekly robotaxi rides: Waymo (2025) vs. Cruise (shut down)

source.name: Robotaxi industry status: GM/Cruise wind-down vs. Waymo ride figures
source.publisher: GM investor announcement and Waymo ride figures, via Reuters/TechCrunch reporting

notes: GM announced in December 2024 it would stop funding Cruise's robotaxi development and wind the driverless ride-hailing business down entirely, after Cruise had already suspended all driverless operations in October 2023 following a pedestrian-dragging incident. Waymo, by contrast, was providing about 200,000 paid rides a week in early 2025.
